summary: Join retirement portfolio construction course to gain valuable insights and skills for effective management. Secure your financial future with expert guidance.
lede: Retirement portfolio construction and management provides a disciplined way to connect investment decisions with real-life retirement goals and risks. This course shows how to define objectives, assess risk capacity and tolerance, select asset classes, and build accumulation and decumulation strategies designed for more than short-term performance. For pension schemes, retirement planners, and those advising employees, the course offers a practical framework for constructing, reviewing, monitoring, and defending portfolio decisions. Through hands-on, scenario-based learning, participants develop strategies that address diversification, suitability, sustainability, asset allocation, risk management, and retirement income needs.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who design, manage, or influence retirement savings and investment decisions.
audience: Trustees and members of pension fund boards
Portfolio managers focused on long-term retirement mandates
modules: Foundations of Retirement Planning and Portfolio Thinking
Defining Retirement Goals, Profiles, and Constraints
Asset Classes and Instruments for Retirement Portfolios
Retirement Income Strategies and Decumulation Planning
Designing and Managing Employer-Sponsored Retirement Plans
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of investment principles and experience with financial planning or portfolio management.
